title: Avoid aggregate function uppercase allocation
description: Replace AggregateAccumulator function-name to_uppercase matching with ASCII case-insensitive comparisons.

criteria: AggregateAccumulator::new no longer allocates a to_uppercase string for function matching
AggregateAccumulator::with_input_capacity no longer allocates a to_uppercase string for function matching
ASCII case-insensitive matching still recognizes supported aggregate names

notes: The helper uses str::eq_ignore_ascii_case, matching the codebase's existing ASCII SQL function-name style.
Accumulator variants and fallback-to-count behavior are unchanged.
Capacity behavior for collecting accumulators remains unchanged.
